relationship: keeps atlas family together; CT-only training lacks distal support
measurement_scope: synthetic label-blind ultrasound echoes and tracker poses, not B-mode or robot trials

methodology.pairing: same immutable simulator episode for all six methods; offset levels also share tape seeds
methodology.confidence_intervals: 95% percentile episode-cluster bootstrap; paired draws across methods/offsets; source/station stratified for balanced comparisons, IID for risk
methodology.role_f1: pooled macro-F1 over vessel roles with truth support; argmax predictions, merged truth contributes 1/k per contributor; NULL reported separately
methodology.tracking: primary world XYZ Euclidean RMSE on finite frame-role pairs contributing to rendered echoes, including merge contributors; all-slice (including unobserved) RMSE and both coverage denominators reported separately. Paired Wilcoxon uses common observed pairs in each episode.
methodology.mcnemar: exact two-sided, one binary outcome per tape: station acquisition argmax, or first anonymous echo of the indicated frame (membership in merged truth counts as correct); empty endpoint excluded in both arms
methodology.station: five-way argmax of mean frame posteriors across the acquisition, abstain if unsupported; no test-label masking; macro-F1 over prescribed classes, undefined if any expected class lacks truth
methodology.retroactive: compare online prefix output against history after the midpoint recheck and all remaining frames; test paired first echo in the first frame
methodology.latency: wall-clock reader.step only, per frame; history relabelling timed separately; does not include simulation, metric extraction or reset
methodology.conformal: Full uses a frozen rank threshold; other readers and the Full nominal control use an unadjusted threshold with no rank claim. Conditional certification risk has no marginal conformal guarantee.

medseg_right.support_policy: archived sampled/interpolated centers and links; gaps remain NaN/False

shared_geometry_provenance.coordinate_frame: neutral SMPL-X world XYZ mm; y is longitudinal

training_provenance.conformal_sampling: IID uniform training source, then uniform supported station, then independent scan seed

offset.offset_axis: commanded circumferential material-arc mm, not achieved Euclidean translation
offset.probe_aim: baseline aim from training anatomy only; recentered by commanded arc divided by local chart reference radius, without using held-out lumen positions or echoes
